title: 3,500 lb Teardrop & Pop-Up Campers
examples: Airstream Basecamp 16, Forest River Rockwood Geo Pro, Casita Spirit 17, 17ft Bass Boat
description: Lightweight fiberglass, pop-up, and single-axle adventure trailers suitable for midsize crossovers, unibody pickups, and off-road SUVs.

title: 5,000 lb Compact Travel Trailers & Boats
examples: Jayco Jay Feather Micro, Winnebago Micro Minnie, 20ft Fiberglass Bowrider Boat, Dual-Axle Utility Trailer
description: The most popular entry-level family camper weight bracket. Requires careful payload verification on midsize 3-row SUVs due to 600+ lb tongue weights.

title: 6,500 lb Family Bunkhouse Travel Trailers
examples: Grand Design Imagine XLS 23BHE, Keystone Passport 2400RB, Airstream Flying Cloud 23FB, 22ft Wakeboard Boat
description: Mid-weight dual-axle travel trailers with slide-outs and bunkhouses. Often pushes midsize trucks and full-size SUVs right to their payload ceiling.

title: 8,000 lb Full-Size Slide-Out Travel Trailers
hitchType: Class IV WDH w/ Integrated Sway Control
examples: Grand Design Imagine 2800BH, Forest River Cherokee Grey Wolf, 2-Horse Bumper Pull Trailer, Enclosed Car Hauler
description: Heavy half-ton territory. With over 1,000 lbs of loaded tongue weight plus a 100 lb weight-distribution hitch, payload capacity becomes the primary limiting factor.

title: 10,000 lb Toy Haulers & Heavy Equipment Trailers
examples: Grand Design Momentum G-Class, Skid Steer Equipment Trailer, 28ft Offshore Center Console Boat, 3-Horse Slant Load
description: Demands high-output half-ton trucks with Max Tow packages or 3/4-ton (2500-series) heavy-duty pickups for safe mountain grade braking and cooling.

title: 13,000 lb Mid-Profile Fifth-Wheel RVs
examples: Grand Design Reflection 150 Series, Cougar Half-Ton 5th Wheel, Mini-Excavator Dump Trailer
description: Fifth-wheel trailers place 17% to 20% of their gross weight directly onto the truck bed pin. Nearly all half-ton trucks run out of payload before reaching 13,000 lbs.

title: 16,000 lb Luxury Fifth-Wheels & Goosenecks
examples: Montana High Country, Grand Design Solitude, 30ft Gooseneck Flatbed w/ Tractor, 4-Horse Living Quarters
description: Strictly 3/4-ton (2500HD) and 1-ton (3500) heavy-duty truck territory. Generates 3,000+ lbs of vertical bed pin weight plus 200 lbs of hitch hardware.

title: 22,000 lb Triple-Axle Toy Haulers & Commercial Goosenecks
examples: Grand Design Momentum 395MS, Brinkley Model G, 40ft Tandem-Dual Hotshot Gooseneck
description: Extreme heavy-haul class requiring high-torque 6.7L/6.6L turbo-diesel powertrains, exhaust brakes, and 1-ton SRW or DRW (dually) rear axle payload ratings.
